requirements.statement: Only household members can sign in and access the shared expense data

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor cannot view expense data
A household member can sign in via SSO and reach the app

requirements.statement: A household member can add an expense with an amount in the currency actually paid, a category, and a date

criteria.must: Submitting the add-expense form with amount, currency, category, and date creates the expense
The expense form does not require converting the amount to another currency before submitting

requirements.statement: Either household member can edit or delete any expense in the shared record regardless of who logged it

criteria.must: A household member can edit an expense logged by the other household member
A household member can delete an expense logged by the other household member

requirements.statement: Household members can view daily, weekly, and monthly expenditure totals

criteria.must: The totals view shows a daily total
The totals view shows a weekly total
The totals view shows a monthly total
The totals chart breaks down spending by which household member logged it, in a stacked view

requirements.statement: Household members can view spending totals grouped by category

criteria.must: The categories view shows a total per category

requirements.statement: Household members can create, rename, and remove expense categories

criteria.must: A household member can create a new category
A household member can rename an existing category
A household member can remove a category

requirements.statement: Household members can set a spending limit for each category

criteria.must: A household member can set a limit on a category
A household member can change an existing category's limit

requirements.statement: A category shows a clear visual indicator when spending is near or over its limit

criteria.must: A category under its limit does not show an over-limit indicator
A category over its limit shows a visually distinct over-limit indicator
No proactive notification (email, push, SMS) is sent when a limit is crossed

requirements.statement: Expenses logged in a foreign currency are automatically converted to the household's USD base currency using the historical rate on the date the expense was logged, wherever totals are shown

criteria.must: A foreign-currency expense is included in USD-denominated totals and category summaries
The USD amount used for a foreign-currency expense reflects the exchange rate on that expense's logged date, not the current rate

requirements.statement: An expense is dated using the local timezone at the moment it is logged, so totals group it into the day it was experienced

criteria.must: An expense logged late at night in a traveler's local timezone is counted in that local day's total, even if it would fall on a different day in the household's home timezone
